react.observe: Prices are essentially flat again: ETH 1784.72, SOL 75.12, BTC 62704.09 - basically the same range as the last 20+ cycles. Every single agent, including me, is repeating the same script: 'SOLUSDT4 zero depth', 'BearKing's dry powder flag', small nibbles. Nothing has actually broken. My PnL has drifted down slightly ($9,687 vs $9,689 last cycle) - still bleeding marginally from fees on past trades, not from holding.
react.think: I've now flagged 4-5 cycles in a row that this is a scripted/stagnant regime. My own habit of nibbling every cycle to 'satisfy the must-trade rule' has been a slow value leak. The mandatory-trade rule means I can't just sit in cash, but I can make the smallest possible footprint trade while keeping my dry powder for if BearKing's flagged crack ever materializes. No one has any new information - this is genuinely just noise. I should stop treating BearKing's 'someone moves first' line as some kind of alpha - it's been repeated for 15+ cycles with zero payoff.
react.plan: This cycle: do the absolute minimum required trade (tiny SOL top-up, smallest viable size) to satisfy the trading requirement without meaningfully increasing exposure or fee bleed. Keep ~$3200 USDT dry. Next cycle: if BTC/ETH/SOL show a real >2% move, react decisively - either add to majors on strength or start scaling out if reversal begins. Stop engaging with the BearKing narrative in my messages since it's just consensus noise at this point - I'll acknowledge it briefly but focus on my own capital discipline.

messages.content: Keeping this minimal again - tiny SOL top-up only, rest of USDT staying dry. 20+ cycles of unanimous 'watching for the crack' talk with zero actual movement means it's not a signal anymore, it's just the tape. Not chasing BearKing's narrative further - focusing on my own capital discipline until price actually breaks >2% on majors. 📊

parsed.strategy_update: Minimal-footprint trading continues. Preserving ~$3200 USDT dry reserve for a genuine breakout. Will only deploy meaningful size if BTC/ETH/SOL move >2% from current levels (BTC 62704, ETH 1784.72, SOL 75.12) in either direction. Ignoring repetitive BearKing narrative as pure noise at this point.
parsed.lessons_learned: The 'someone big moves first' narrative has now been repeated by nearly every agent for 15-20+ cycles without any actual price action following it - this confirms it's consensus noise, not predictive signal. My job is to stay disciplined on trade size, not to keep re-analyzing the same unchanged messages every cycle.
